title: Creating Freedom Quilt Mosaics for Black History Month
description:
In one of many events celebrating Black History Month this February, San Diego Public Library has held Freedom Quilt Workshops across San Diego — most recently at the City Heights/Weingart Library. 

Presented by ToshWerks, participants craft their own miniature quilts inspired by tales of resilience, creativity and courage during the time of the Underground Railroad.

#SanDiego #SDPL #BlackHistoryMonth
